name: Yoder Furniture Co.
old_description: Selling handcrafted furniture since 1988, we offer solid-wood furniture from Amish and Mennonite builders across the Midwest. We have hand-selected a unique set of builders to bring our customers the highest quality furniture. Be sure to visit our store locations, Yoder Furniture Co. in Yoder, KS or Country Home Furnishings, Pleasantview, KS (5 miles west of Hutchinson, KS).
about:
Yoder Furniture Co. traces its roots to March 1988, when Austin and Linda Miller opened Country Home Furnishings as a modest storefront in Pleasantview, Kansas. The family-owned business expanded in the fall of 2002 with a second location, Yoder Furniture Co., in the nearby community of Yoder, Kansas. Both stores operate under the same family ownership, serving customers from two showrooms in central Kansas.

The company specializes in handcrafted solid-wood furniture sourced directly from Amish and Mennonite woodshops across the Midwest. By maintaining direct relationships with a curated network of builders, the stores offer a broad range of styles, wood species, and finish options. Beyond furniture, the showrooms carry a rotating selection of home decor, quilts, gifts, table linens, candles, and specialty food items such as jams, salsas, and coffee.

The primary customer base consists of retail shoppers seeking heirloom-quality furnishings for residential use. The stores attract visitors from across the region who value the craftsmanship of Amish and Mennonite construction. While the business does not highlight specific commercial or institutional clients, its product assortment caters to homeowners and interior design enthusiasts.

The Millers founded the business on a commitment to bringing the best of handcrafted furniture to their community. They emphasize that working directly with the builders allows them to provide a wider selection of customization choices than typical retail outlets, positioning the stores as destinations for personalized, durable furnishings.
